title: Hide sqlx behind fieldwork's public API
description: fieldwork currently exposes sqlx types in its public API (Pool enum wraps sqlx::SqlitePool/PgPool, functions return sqlx::Error). The servers must import sqlx just to construct the Pool and handle errors. Fix: fieldwork should own pool construction (connect function), wrap sqlx::Error in its own error type, and not leak sqlx types. Then servers can drop the sqlx dependency entirely.
close_reason: sqlx removed from all server Cargo.tomls. sqlite/postgres references removed from all business logic. Database backend is fully encapsulated behind fieldwork::db::Pool.
